faqs.question: How do I place an order for gas stoves or accessories?
faqs.answer: Ordering is as simple as sending a WhatsApp message! Browse our catalog, add items to your cart, or click "Order on WhatsApp" on any product page. When you confirm your cart, a prefilled WhatsApp message with your selected items, prices, and address will be created. Simply send the message to 03432833991, and our representative will confirm availability and delivery details.

faqs.question: Are your stoves compatible with Sui Gas (Natural Gas) or LPG cylinders?
faqs.answer: Most of our stoves and hobs are designed to support both Natural Gas (Sui Gas) and LPG cylinders. Stoves are fitted with precision nozzles suited for standard Sui Gas pressure, and can easily be converted for LPG with our LPG nozzle kit. Please inform us about your gas type during WhatsApp ordering so we ensure proper calibration.

faqs.question: What are the delivery charges and delivery times across Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Delivery charges vary depending on your destination city, package dimensions, and whether you order small accessories or heavy cast iron stoves. All final delivery fees and transit schedules will be confirmed clearly with you over WhatsApp before shipping.

faqs.question: How do I fix a yellow flame or low heat on my existing burner?
faqs.answer: A yellow flame typically occurs when dust, burnt grease, or oil spills clog the burner air vents or brass nozzle orifice. This causes incomplete combustion and black soot. You can clean the burner caps and clear the nozzle hole using our Stove Maintenance & Nozzle Cleaning Wire Kit, which restores a crisp, fuel-efficient blue flame.

faqs.question: What safety precautions should I take with gas cylinders and regulators?
faqs.answer: Always use certified low-pressure regulators with built-in pressure indicators for home cooking, and inspect rubber pipes regularly for cracks or brittleness. We strongly recommend our steel-wire braided safety hose, which prevents rodent damage and bursting. Never test for gas leaks with a flame; always use soapy water.

faqs.question: What is your return or replacement policy for damaged items?
faqs.answer: We inspect every item prior to dispatch. If your package arrives damaged during courier transit, please notify us within 24–48 hours on WhatsApp with photos or an unboxing video. We will coordinate an inspection and arrange a replacement or refund according to our policy.
